retirement.reason: The lane included TP3 and TP4 components, below the user-required minimum configured target of 5 XAUUSD price dollars.

selection_warning: The component profiles and their one-open combination were selected after 2023 discovery and 2024-2026 diagnostic inspection. This historical result is retained only to explain why the candidate was retired.
objective: Historical attempt to increase monthly coverage using fixed stops between 3 and 5 USD-price.

COMP_DAY_LONG.mechanism: bullish inside-bar plus NR7 compression breakout with H1/H4 alignment
COMP_DAY_LONG.entry_quality: breakout at least 0.10 M15 ATR above the prior high and bullish body fraction at least 0.50

COMP_NIGHT_LONG.mechanism: bullish inside-bar plus NR7 compression breakout with H1/H4 alignment
COMP_NIGHT_LONG.entry_quality: breakout at least 0.10 M15 ATR above the prior high and bullish body fraction at least 0.50

ROLL20_NIGHT_LONG.mechanism: M15 sweeps the prior rolling 20-bar low by at least 0.30 ATR and closes back above it

BLOCK_SWEEP_SHORT.mechanism: completed MT5-server 07-13 range high is swept by at least 0.30 ATR and rejected with upper wick at least 0.15 and close in the lower 25 percent

historical_strong_cost.scenario: spread 2x plus 0.10 USD-price entry and exit slippage

limitations: The lane violated the current minimum TP5 rule.
It lost money in April, May and June 2026-to-cutoff despite a positive 2026 aggregate.
It must not be implemented, promoted, or used as a source candidate.
